```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment = NA)

library(icesTAF)

library(FLCore)
library(stockassessment)
library(FLSAM)

library(tidyverse)
library(pander)

reportPath     <- file.path(".", "report")

```


```{r echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.asp=0.6, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(reportPath,'input', "input_catch_SOP_fig.png"))
```
**Figure 1. Sardine in the North West Africa region - Input data. Comparison of report catch tonnage against catch tonnage calculated from the catch at age matrix and catch weights at age, so called Sum Of Product (SOP). The comparison is made for sub-regions A+B and C (a) and for the combination of those two sub-regions (b).**

**Figure 26. Sardine in the North West Africa region. SSB and fishing mortality relative to SBMSY and FMSY for using the results of the stock assessment models applied to sub-regions A+B, C and combined. The results of the stock assessments for sub-regions A+B and C are only illustrative because only the stock assessment using the combining of input data for sub-regions A+B and C underwent extensive scrutiny and exemplified acceptable model properties.**

\newpage


```{r echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.asp=0.6, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE} 
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(reportPath,'stf', "stf_stf_fig.png")) 
```

**Figure 27. Sardine in the North West Africa region. Short term projections (SSB, fishing mortality and catch) of the stock using the results of the assessment using the combining of input data for sub-regions A+B and C. The following scenarios are provided: status quo in Catch (Csq), status quo in fishing mortality (fsq), no fishing (nf), recovery to SBMSY as soon as possible (SBMSY), recovery to SBMSY with a cap (10%/20%/30%) on yearly catch decrease (SBMSY.C.cap10/20/30).**
